summary.zh: 鼠标靠近按钮时，按钮被轻轻吸向鼠标（只对鼠标有效）
summary.en: The button drifts slightly toward the cursor as it approaches (mouse only)

dont_use.zh: 表单提交按钮；手机端；需要精确点击的小按钮；同一屏多个。只给首屏主行动按钮。
dont_use.en: Form submit buttons, phones, small precise targets, several per view. Hero call-to-action only.

summary.zh: 按下去时按钮轻轻缩小到 96%，松手弹回
summary.en: The button shrinks to 96% while pressed and springs back on release

dont_use.zh: 链接样式的文字按钮（缩放会显得奇怪）

summary.zh: 页面载入后按钮外圈发出 3 次光波提醒，然后停下
summary.en: Three halo pulses after load to draw attention, then it stops

motions.ref: Magic UI · Pulsating Button（独立实现）

dont_use.zh: 同一屏多个；删除、取消等次要或危险按钮；无限循环。只给想让用户注意的那一个按钮。
dont_use.en: Several per view; delete/cancel buttons; endless loops. Only the one button you want noticed.

summary.zh: 点击时从点击位置扩散一圈涟漪，键盘触发时从中心扩散
summary.en: A ripple spreads from the click point; from the centre when triggered by keyboard

motions.ref: Magic UI · Ripple Button（独立实现）

dont_use.zh: 很小的图标按钮；点击后立刻跳转或消失的按钮；按钮上有超出边框的角标（会被裁掉）
dont_use.en: Tiny icon buttons; buttons that navigate or vanish instantly; buttons with badges overflowing the border (they get clipped)

summary.zh: 鼠标放上去或键盘聚焦时，一道亮光从按钮左边扫到右边
summary.en: On hover or keyboard focus, a band of light sweeps across the button

motions.ref: Magic UI · Shimmer Button（独立实现）

dont_use.zh: 同一屏多个按钮同时用；次要按钮；密集工具栏。只给主按钮。
dont_use.en: Several buttons in one view, secondary buttons, dense toolbars. Primary button only.

summary.zh: 所有按钮都有按下回弹和点击涟漪；只有主按钮有悬停流光。适合学习、工具、后台类产品。
summary.en: Every button gets press bounce and click ripple; only primary buttons get the hover shimmer. Good for learning apps, tools and dashboards.

summary.zh: 所有按钮只有按下回弹；首屏主行动按钮额外有磁吸和流光。适合营销页、作品集。
summary.en: Every button gets press bounce only; the hero call-to-action also gets magnetic pull and shimmer. For marketing pages and portfolios.
